blocks.zh_html: IP 多播(IP multicast)

blocks.en: Brief History of IP Multicast
blocks.en_html: Brief History of IP Multicast
blocks.zh_html: IP 多播简史

blocks.en: IP multicast was actively researched and developed in the 1990s and 2000s. The development was motivated by the expectation that the killer application for the Internet would be live-streamed TV or radio. (Fun fact: One of the earliest live-streamed concerts was the Rolling Stones in 1994.)
blocks.en_html: IP multicast was actively researched and developed in the 1990s and 2000s. The development was motivated by the expectation that the killer application for the Internet would be live-streamed TV or radio. (Fun fact: One of the earliest live-streamed concerts was the Rolling Stones in 1994.)
blocks.zh_html: IP 多播(IP multicast)在 1990 年代和 2000 年代得到了积极的研究和开发。其发展动力源于一种预期：互联网的杀手级应用将是实时流媒体电视或广播。（趣味事实：最早的流媒体直播音乐会之一是 1994 年的滚石乐队演唱会。）

blocks.en: Looking back, the IP multicast protocols developed in the 1990s and 2000s had mixed success in terms of adoption. Modern routers do offer support for the IP multicast protocols we’ll see, but network operators don’t always enable these protocols on the routers. (Disabling the protocol on the router essentially means that the router doesn’t understand or support that protocol.)
blocks.en_html: Looking back, the IP multicast protocols developed in the 1990s and 2000s had mixed success in terms of adoption. Modern routers do offer support for the IP multicast protocols we’ll see, but network operators don’t always enable these protocols on the routers. (Disabling the protocol on the router essentially means that the router doesn’t understand or support that protocol.)
blocks.zh_html: 回顾来看，1990 年代和 2000 年代开发的 IP 多播协议在采用方面取得了混合的成功。现代路由器确实支持我们将要看到的 IP 多播协议，但网络运维人员并不总是在路由器上启用这些协议。（在路由器上禁用协议实质上意味着路由器不理解或不支持该协议。）

blocks.en: IP multicast protocols are sometimes used within individual domains (e.g. inside a datacenter network). However, IP multicast protocols are rarely/never deployed across different domains. This means that users cannot expect to use IP multicast at the global Internet level, e.g. if a group of users around the world joined a multicast group, the modern Internet would not automatically support multicasting packets to that group.
blocks.en_html: IP multicast protocols are sometimes used within individual domains (e.g. inside a datacenter network). However, IP multicast protocols are rarely/never deployed across different domains. This means that users cannot expect to use IP multicast at the global Internet level, e.g. if a group of users around the world joined a multicast group, the modern Internet would not automatically support multicasting packets to that group.
blocks.zh_html: IP 多播协议有时在单个域内使用（例如在数据中心网络内部）。然而，IP 多播协议很少/从未跨不同域部署。这意味着用户不能指望在全局互联网级别使用 IP 多播，例如，如果世界各地的用户加入了一个多播组，现代互联网不会自动支持向该组多播分组。

blocks.en: Although these protocols were not globally deployed, the techniques used in these protocols can be applied to solve different networking problems. In particular, these techniques have become relevant again for solving problems related to AI training (we’ll study this when we discuss collectives).
blocks.en_html: Although these protocols were not globally deployed, the techniques used in these protocols can be applied to solve different networking problems. In particular, these techniques have become relevant again for solving problems related to AI training (we’ll study this when we discuss collectives).
blocks.zh_html: 尽管这些协议没有在全局范围内部署，但其中使用的技术可以应用于解决不同的网络问题。特别是，这些技术再次变得相关，用于解决与 AI 训练相关的问题（我们将在讨论集合操作(collectives)时研究这一点）。

blocks.en: IP Multicast Service Model
blocks.en_html: IP Multicast Service Model
blocks.zh_html: IP 多播服务模型(IP Multicast Service Model)

blocks.en: How do we define a group? Each multicast group is defined by an IP address. The addresses from 224.0.0.0 to 239.255.255.255 are multicast addresses, and everyone knows that addresses in this hard-coded range are multicast addresses.
blocks.en_html: How do we define a group? Each multicast group is defined by an IP address. The addresses from 224.0.0.0 to 239.255.255.255 are multicast addresses, and everyone knows that addresses in this hard-coded range are multicast addresses.
blocks.zh_html: 我们如何定义一个组？每个多播组由一个 IP 地址定义。从 224.0.0.0 到 239.255.255.255 的地址是多播地址(multicast addresses)，每个人都知道这个硬编码范围内的地址是多播地址。

blocks.en: To join a group, you will announce the multicast address of the group you want to join. At least one router should hear your message (e.g. your home router), and then the routers will coordinate amongst themselves to spread this information (e.g. with a routing protocol). Eventually, all the routers will have learned that you are part of that group.
blocks.en_html: To join a group, you will announce the multicast address of the group you want to join. At least one router should hear your message (e.g. your home router), and then the routers will coordinate amongst themselves to spread this information (e.g. with a routing protocol). Eventually, all the routers will have learned that you are part of that group.
blocks.zh_html: 要加入一个组，你需要宣告你想加入的组的多播地址。至少有一个路由器应该听到你的消息（例如你的家庭路由器），然后路由器之间会协调以传播这个信息（例如通过路由协议）。最终，所有路由器都会了解到你是该组的一部分。

blocks.en: Similarly, you can announce that you are leaving a group, and you again use the multicast address to identify which group you are talking about.
blocks.en_html: Similarly, you can announce that you are leaving a group, and you again use the multicast address to identify which group you are talking about.
blocks.zh_html: 类似地，你可以宣告你正在离开一个组，也是用多播地址来标识你谈论的是哪个组。

blocks.en: To send a packet to a group, all you need to do is fill in the multicast group address as the IP destination field. Then, the routers will use that group address to forward the packet to all group members. Notice that as the sender, you don’t need to worry about who belongs to the group, because the routers will figure that out for you.
blocks.en_html: To send a packet to a group, all you need to do is fill in the multicast group address as the IP destination field. Then, the routers will use that group address to forward the packet to all group members. Notice that as the sender, you don’t need to worry about who belongs to the group, because the routers will figure that out for you.
blocks.zh_html: 要向一个组发送分组，你只需要在 IP 目的字段中填入多播组地址即可。然后，路由器会使用该组地址将分组转发给所有组成员。注意，作为发送方，你不需要担心谁属于该组，因为路由器会为你处理好。

blocks.en: In summary, the IP multicast service model defines three operations for end hosts: You can send packets to a group (even if you are not a part of that group yourself). You can announce that you are joining a group. You can announce that you are leaving a group. In all three operations, your job is just to send out packets. The routers will process those packets, coordinate with each other (e.g. run a routing protocol), and decide how to route multicast packets accordingly.
blocks.en_html: In summary, the IP multicast service model defines three operations for end hosts: You can send packets to a group (even if you are not a part of that group yourself). You can announce that you are joining a group. You can announce that you are leaving a group. In all three operations, your job is just to send out packets. The routers will process those packets, coordinate with each other (e.g. run a routing protocol), and decide how to route multicast packets accordingly.
blocks.zh_html: 总结一下，IP 多播服务模型为终端主机(end hosts)定义了三种操作：你可以向一个组发送分组（即使你自己不是该组的成员）；你可以宣告你正在加入一个组；你可以宣告你正在离开一个组。在所有三种操作中，你的工作只是发出分组。路由器会处理这些分组，相互协调（例如运行路由协议），并据此决定如何路由多播分组。

blocks.en: Now that we know how hosts interact with IP multicasting (sending, joining, and leaving), we can think about how routers deliver multicast packets.
blocks.en_html: Now that we know how hosts interact with IP multicasting (sending, joining, and leaving), we can think about how routers deliver multicast packets.
blocks.zh_html: 现在我们知道主机如何与 IP 多播交互（发送、加入和离开），我们可以考虑路由器如何交付多播分组。

blocks.en: In the unicast model, a router receives a packet and forwards the packet along a single next-hop. Now, in the IP multicast model, when a router receives a multicast packet (i.e. destination is a multicast group address), the router will forward the packet along zero, one, or multiple outgoing links, so that the packet reaches all group members.
blocks.en_html: In the unicast model, a router receives a packet and forwards the packet along a single next-hop. Now, in the IP multicast model, when a router receives a multicast packet (i.e. destination is a multicast group address), the router will forward the packet along zero, one, or multiple outgoing links, so that the packet reaches all group members.
blocks.zh_html: 在单播(unicast)模型中，路由器收到一个分组并将其转发到单一的下一跳(next-hop)。现在，在 IP 多播模型中，当路由器收到一个多播分组（即目的地址是多播组地址）时，路由器将沿着零条、一条或多条出向链路转发该分组，以便分组到达所有组成员。

blocks.en: To implement multicast, the router needs some additional state to keep track of group membership, so that the router can forward the packet to only the next-hops that lead toward the group members. If a next-hop doesn’t lead to any group members, there’s no need to send the packet along that next-hop. As users join and leave the group, a router’s next-hops for that group might change.
blocks.en_html: To implement multicast, the router needs some additional state to keep track of group membership, so that the router can forward the packet to only the next-hops that lead toward the group members. If a next-hop doesn’t lead to any group members, there’s no need to send the packet along that next-hop. As users join and leave the group, a router’s next-hops for that group might change.
blocks.zh_html: 为了实现多播，路由器需要一些额外的状态来追踪组成员关系，以便路由器只将分组转发给那些通向组成员的下一跳。如果某个下一跳不通往任何组成员，就没有必要沿着那个下一跳发送分组。随着用户加入和离开组，路由器对该组的下一跳可能会改变。

blocks.en: Implementing Multicast
blocks.en_html: Implementing Multicast
blocks.zh_html: 实现多播

blocks.en: With our service model defined, we are now ready to implement IP multicasting in routers. Remember our end goal here: Users interact with the network by sending packets, announcing joins, and announcing leaves. The routers must take this information and use it to correctly forward multicast packets to all members of that group (as defined by the multicast address).
blocks.en_html: With our service model defined, we are now ready to implement IP multicasting in routers. Remember our end goal here: Users interact with the network by sending packets, announcing joins, and announcing leaves. The routers must take this information and use it to correctly forward multicast packets to all members of that group (as defined by the multicast address).
blocks.zh_html: 服务模型定义好了，现在我们准备在路由器中实现 IP 多播。请记住我们的最终目标：用户通过网络发送分组、宣告加入和宣告离开来与网络交互。路由器必须获取这些信息，并用它来正确地将多播分组转发给该组的所有成员（由多播地址定义）。

blocks.en: We can divide this problem into two parts:
blocks.en_html: We can divide this problem into two parts:
blocks.zh_html: 我们可以把这个问题分成两部分：

blocks.en: How do routers know what groups their directly-connected hosts belong to? We’ll use a protocol called IGMP to solve this.
blocks.en_html: How do routers know what groups their directly-connected hosts belong to? We’ll use a protocol called IGMP to solve this.
blocks.zh_html: 路由器如何知道其直连主机属于哪些组？我们将使用一个叫做 IGMP 的协议来解决这个问题。

blocks.en: How do routers forward packets through the network to reach the destination group members? We’ll look at two protocols for solving this: DVMRP and CBT. Both protocols achieve the same goal, so you can pick either one for your implementation (the same way you can pick either distance-vector or link-state, but not both).
blocks.en_html: How do routers forward packets through the network to reach the destination group members? We’ll look at two protocols for solving this: DVMRP and CBT. Both protocols achieve the same goal, so you can pick either one for your implementation (the same way you can pick either distance-vector or link-state, but not both).
blocks.zh_html: 路由器如何通过网络转发分组以到达目的组成员？我们将研究两种解决这个问题的协议：DVMRP 和 CBT。两种协议都能达到相同的目标，所以你可以选择其中任何一种来实现（就像你可以选择距离向量或链路状态，但不需要同时选择两者）。

blocks.en: IGMP: Directly-Connected Hosts
blocks.en_html: IGMP: Directly-Connected Hosts
blocks.zh_html: IGMP：直连主机

blocks.en: Before we solve the larger problem of multicast routing, let’s start with a smaller problem. Suppose a router is directly connected to many hosts. The router needs some way to know which group(s) each host belongs to. We’ll use a protocol called IGMP (Internet Group Management Protocol) to achieve this.
blocks.en_html: Before we solve the larger problem of multicast routing, let’s start with a smaller problem. Suppose a router is directly connected to many hosts. The router needs some way to know which group(s) each host belongs to. We’ll use a protocol called IGMP (Internet Group Management Protocol) to achieve this.
blocks.zh_html: 在我们解决更大的多播路由问题之前，先从一个较小的问题开始。假设一个路由器直连了许多主机。路由器需要某种方式来知道每个主机属于哪个（哪些）组。我们将使用一个叫做 IGMP（互联网组管理协议，Internet Group Management Protocol）的协议来实现这一点。

blocks.en: At a high level, the router and the hosts exchange messages so that the router is informed about everybody’s group membership(s). Some types of messages that can be exchanged:
blocks.en_html: At a high level, the router and the hosts exchange messages so that the router is informed about everybody’s group membership(s). Some types of messages that can be exchanged:
blocks.zh_html: 在高层面上，路由器和主机之间交换消息，以便路由器了解每个人的组成员关系。可以交换的消息类型包括：

blocks.en: Queries: The router periodically sends Queries to the hosts. These messages ask: What group(s) do you belong to?
blocks.en_html: Queries: The router periodically sends Queries to the hosts. These messages ask: What group(s) do you belong to?
blocks.zh_html: 查询(Queries)：路由器定期向主机发送查询。这些消息问的是：你属于哪个（哪些）组？

blocks.en: Reports: In response, hosts send Reports back to the router. Reports answer the question: These are the group(s) I belong to. Hosts can also send unsolicited Reports (i.e. without waiting for a Query).
blocks.en_html: Reports: In response, hosts send Reports back to the router. Reports answer the question: These are the group(s) I belong to. Hosts can also send unsolicited Reports (i.e. without waiting for a Query).
blocks.zh_html: 报告(Reports)：作为响应，主机向路由器发送报告。报告回答了问题：这是我所属的组。主机也可以发送未经请求的报告（即不等待查询）。

blocks.en: By periodically exchanging Queries and Reports, the router stays informed about the latest group membership(s). If the router doesn’t receive a Report about a membership for a long time, the router will assume that membership has expired and invalidate it.
blocks.en_html: By periodically exchanging Queries and Reports, the router stays informed about the latest group membership(s). If the router doesn’t receive a Report about a membership for a long time, the router will assume that membership has expired and invalidate it.
blocks.zh_html: 通过定期交换查询和报告，路由器始终了解最新的组成员关系。如果路由器长时间没有收到关于某个成员关系的报告，就会假定该成员关系已过期并将其失效。

blocks.en: IGMP helps routers learn about directly-connected hosts. However, routers still don’t know anything about other hosts elsewhere in the network, so we’ll need routing algorithms for those.
blocks.en_html: IGMP helps routers learn about directly-connected hosts. However, routers still don’t know anything about other hosts elsewhere in the network, so we’ll need routing algorithms for those.
blocks.zh_html: IGMP 帮助路由器了解直连主机。然而，路由器仍然不知道网络中其他位置的其他主机，因此我们还需要路由算法来处理那些。

blocks.en: To draw a comparison to distance-vector routing, you can think of IGMP as the multicast version of static routing, where a router learns about its directly-connected hosts (but not other hosts elsewhere in the network).
blocks.en_html: To draw a comparison to distance-vector routing, you can think of IGMP as the multicast version of static routing, where a router learns about its directly-connected hosts (but not other hosts elsewhere in the network).
blocks.zh_html: 与距离向量路由进行对比，你可以将 IGMP 看作多播版本的静态路由，即路由器了解其直连主机（但不了解网络中其他位置的主机）。
